description: This file is a shell script that contains tests for Git's 'read-tree' command, specifically testing rejection of confusing or problematic path names under different configurations. It sets up test repositories, enables specific Git configurations, and performs various test cases to ensure 'read-tree' behaves as expected with complex file paths.
